evidence_scope: Current Xenoverse 2-specific mechanics/provenance review for the live canonical record.
findings: 100-Ki Ki Blast Super from the Conton City Tournament progression. The user places a clock-like sigil that fires a delayed beam; charging can delay firing, while an additional input fires placed rays immediately. Holy Inscription hits allow up to three simultaneous sigils, and using the technique resets the Holy Inscription hit counter.
